caption:
You've been burned by software before.

Sign up, load in every contact, then hit a wall the day you try to leave.

Here's the honest answer: on the Black Arrow platform, every contact, text, and lead lives in your account. Export to CSV any time. Cancel whenever you want and walk out with everything you put in.

No card to start. No data held hostage.

DM TRIAL

#ServiceBusiness #CRMforContractors #HomeServices #LeadFollowUp #SmallBusinessGrowth
rationale: Carousels still lead saves/depth for B2B authority content in 2026 benchmarks, and this resolves a genuinely unclaimed objection (data lock-in fear on cancellation) distinct from the impersonal, cost, timing, complexity, staff-redundancy, tried-and-failed, and contract-lock-in objections already shipped.
